title: Tank Dell avoids PUP list to open Texans camp

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Tank Dell avoids PUP list to open Texans camp
sources.description: Wide receiver Tank Dell said in June that he felt he'd be ready to go at the start of training camp and it appears the Texans agree with his assessment of his health.
